title: Ubwiza bw'abashyitsi bwazanye ubwoba
intro: Mu mujyi wari wuzuyemo ububi, umugaragu wizerwa yakiriye abashyitsi batari babyiteze umunsi umwe. Kubera impungenge z'umutekano wabo, uwo muntu yabahaye uburinzi, ariko abaturage b'uwo mujyi bamusaba ikintu giteye isoni. Amaze kuburirwa ibyago byari bigiye kuza, umugaragu yahunze umuryango we wihishe inyuma y'umwijima, asiga umujyi wari ugenewe kurimbuka. Ni nde uyu mwizera wenyine?
clues: Natumwe kuba intumwa ku bantu bakoze ibikorwa by'urukozasoni.
Abashyitsi batunguranye baje iwanjye, kandi nari mfite impungenge z'umutekano wabo kuruta uwanjye.
Abantu banjye basabye kubonana n'abashyitsi banjye kubera imigambi mibi, kandi nagerageje kubasobanurira.
Abashyitsi banjye bigaragaje ko ari abamarayika, bantegeka kujyana umuryango wanjye tukagenda nijoro.
Umugore wanjye ntiyumviye ubutumwa bwo gutoroka maze ahura n'irimbuka nk'iryo abantu banjye bahuye naryo.
Umujyi wanjye warasenyutse n'imvura y'amabuye y'ibumba, ibice byawo byo hejuru bigabanuka cyane.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Gusaba abantu banjye kwegera abashyitsi banjye mu buryo bubi
Gucikamo kabiri kw'inyanja kugira ngo umuntu ahunge umutegetsi w'igitugu
Igitambo cy'umuhungu wanjye mu igeragezwa ry'ukwizera
trial.answer: Gusaba abantu banjye kwegera abashyitsi banjye mu buryo bubi

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Narokowe n'umuryango wanjye mbere y'uko umujyi wanjye utembagazwa
Nayoboye abantu banjye mu bwisanzure hakurya y'inyanja
Nakoze ubwato bunini kandi narokotse umwuzure ukomeye
Nahanganye n'imibabaro nihanganye kandi nahawe ingororano yo kubona umuryango
outcome.answer: Narokowe n'umuryango wanjye mbere y'uko umujyi wanjye utembagazwa

arabic: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
verse: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support." (11:80)
